title: A beautiful day in Barcelona!
text: This was so such a fun experience! Mariana was fun, energetic and the bike itinerary helped to see so much of the city! The el Born and  gothic quarter small alleys were so cool to bike thru there. Afterwards, sailing on the Mediterranean sealed this tour as my favorite of all the activities in Barcelona! We had a beautiful day and Fiona provided plenty of drinks and swim if wanted from the boat. Mariana was a joy to be around and it was great to experience the city with a local-from her favorite coffee shop to cute boutique shops! Thanks again Mariana!
author: Penny_W

title: A Wonderful Off The Beaten Track Afternoon & Evening
text: A great time!!  The Biking and Sailboat Tours took us away from the tourist areas and added to our understanding and appreciation of Barcelona.  Since it was just 2 of us on the bike tour, Mariana offered us options for our ride, and we chose to ride through newer areas of the City and neighorhoods.  We saw so much, and Mariana showed us educated us about current usage and development in the City, taking us to interesting new buildings, developments, art galleries, etc.  Then we went on the sailboat for a lovely sunset view of Barcelona, where we met some fellow travelers and had a great time.
author: jeanetter55

title: Poco de todo!
text: If you want to pack a ton of fun into one day, you can’t miss with the cycling and sailing experience!  Exercise, exploring, learning about the culture and then relaxing on the Mediterranean, perfecto!
author: philbro7

title: Barcelona by bicycle and boat
text: We had the best day.  Maryanna was an amazing tour guide who personalized the tour based on our interests.  We enjoyed riding through some interesting neighborhoods.  We felt like we understood Barcelona better after the bicycle tour.  The boat ride was also a great time.  Another way to experience this beautiful city.  The skipper was super nice and we enjoyed a fun trip on the water.
author: Randy_E

title: The best time ever! Muy divertito
text: The best time ever! The real local experience, such a personalized tour! Such great recommendations! A real local experience to see the real part of Barcelona not just the tourist shops!
author: Amanda_N

title: Amazing trip❤️
text: Mariana is the perfect guide! She takes the tour in your tempo, is so happy, shows local culture, has so many recommendations and is just a ray of sunshine! This was my second tour with her. A few years ago I went with my mom, and now with my boyfriend and friends! It was just an incredible trip, and I dont regret doing it for a second❤️ Will absolutely contact Mariana again❤️
author: Ssaraisa

title: Great guides, wonderful experience!
text:
We had a great experience with our guides, Paulo who was with us for the biking, and Alessio, our boat captain.   Both tailored our experiences so as to maximize our Barcelona tour.
Paulo took us to places we had not yet been, including the Gothic area and to view the Roman ruins ( city walls, remnants of a Roman temple, and a Roman cemetary).    He also took us to some of the local markets, as well as a short walk on the main market street, La Rambla.   We started and ended at Port Orient, where he showed us the growth of the beachfront.
He and Alessio then took us out on a 40 foot sailboat.
